item.coloph: 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi 'grel pa bsdus pa'i gsal ba/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po a ba d+hU tI pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po d+harma shrI mi tra dang / bod gyi lo tsA ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos mdzad kyi sgom pa ye shes grags pa'i don du bsgyur ba'o
